evals.name: request-resolver
evals.prompt: Route each author query by the caller's verified tenant claim.
assertions: Calls UseClaimTenancy naming the tenant_id claim.
Separates tenant selection from membership authorization.

evals.name: membership
evals.prompt: Write the membership check for an identity carrying trusted member_of claims.
assertions: Requires authenticated membership in the selected tenant.
Does not perform I/O or trust command fields.

evals.name: two-catalogs
evals.prompt: Prove two tenants can reuse an author ID without disclosing the other tenant's name.
evals.expected_output: Two isolated caller results and a negative check.
assertions: Uses the same key in both partitions.
Checks only each caller's tenant-specific name is visible.
Refuses a selected tenant with no matching membership.
